input_precision: MD 2 dp; INC 2 dp (one interpolated station 2 dp); AZI 2 dp
output_precision: TVD/N/E/VS 2 dp; DLS 2 dp deg/100 ft as printed
geometric_character: moderate build then hold/drop; max INC ~36.9°; not a horizontal well
transcription_method: RapidOCR on 2x rendered page strips, then row reconstruction and visual header check against the scan
verification_notes: Source PDF is a scanned image (no text layer). Header, VSP 165.30, method, and all station rows were OCR'd with generally high confidence. Printed rounded values are not infinite-precision truth. Golden-test tolerance must be at least the displayed 0.01 ft / 0.01° / 0.01°/100 ft. Station 1848 is labelled Plug Back Interpolated Point.
redistribution: public government filing; retain local copy for research
